message.reasoning_content: We need to identify crimes based on facts. Facts: Defendant Wei coerced Huang to pay 100,000 yuan under threat, detained him, forced him to give bank card and password, then withdrew 159,000 yuan for himself. This is extortion (敲诈勒索) and illegal detention (非法拘禁) maybe also robbery? He used threat to obtain money, that's extortion. Also taking money from bank card after obtaining under duress is theft? But the act of taking money after coercion is part of extortion. Also illegal detention: He and accomplices detained Huang, restricting his personal freedom. That is illegal detention (非法拘禁). So crimes: 敲诈勒索;非法拘禁. Possibly also robbery (抢劫) but robbery requires use of violence or threat to take property directly; here they used threat and detention, could be robbery? Chinese law: robbery (抢劫) is taking property by force, threat of immediate violence. Here they threatened to demand compensation, not immediate violence. So extortion fits. Also "非法占有" of money after obtaining card could be theft (盗窃) but they used threat, so extortion. So answer: [罪名]敲诈勒索;非法拘禁<eoa>
